description:
The Wife Game follows Park Sangcheol, a simple employee on the apartment facility management team. He spends his days fixing various breakdowns around the complex, but his true focus is the married women who live there. What starts as curiosity soon turns into a dangerous game of desire and secrets.

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/uplmscg/episode/toon/8586), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=12431829), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/5700000352), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000069278), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250250)
